item.title: Aftermath of Local Elections…Will Jeong Cheong-rae Enter the August Party Convention? [Gongdeok Pocha] (지방선거 후폭풍…정청래, 8월 전당대회 나갈까?[공덕포차])
item.description:
<<>> ()

The dispute over responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections is escalating into conflict within the Democratic Party ahead of the August party convention. <<> On the morning of the 11th, during a closed-door general meeting of lawmakers, demands for Representative Jeong Cheong-rae to step down erupted. Lawmakers including Jang Cheol-min and Im Mi-ae argued that there was no party-level reflection even after the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election, and that Representative Jeong must immediately resign to ensure neutrality and fair management if he intends to seek re-election. The previous day, at the Supreme Council meeting, Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon announced he would not run, pressuring Representative Jeong, while lawmaker Park Ji-won called for the entire leadership to resign. <<> Amid this pressure, Representative Jeong stated, "Public sentiment is the will of heaven," and "No regime can defeat the people," publicly rebuking President Lee Jae-myung and signaling his will to fight head-on. <<> However, public sentiment is not favorable. According to the National Indicator Survey (NBS) released on the same day by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research, 45% of respondents said the opposition "performed well" in the local elections, surpassing the 31% who said the ruling camp "performed well." <<> President Lee's approval rating for state affairs also dropped to 57%, down 9 percentage points from three weeks ago (66%), while party support rates showed the Democratic Party falling 4 points to 41% and the People Power Party rising 5 points to 25%, narrowing the gap. This survey was conducted from the 8th to the 10th with 1,001 people aged 18 and older. For more details, visit the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee. <<> Amid the heated blame game over the local elections, will Representative Jeong Cheong-rae run for the August party convention? Can President Lee Jae-myung boost his shaken approval ratings? The People Power Party's floor leader primary ended in an unexpectedly tight race, with Representative Jeong Jeom-sik winning by just 7 votes after a runoff—what does this mean? We explore this at Gongdeok Pocha. Check out the video! <<> Production Team

item.title: President Lee: "Korea-Italy relations upgraded to 'Special Strategic Partnership'... Expanding high-tech industry cooperation" (이 대통령 “한-이탈리아 ‘특별 전략적 동반자’로 격상…첨단산업 협력 확대”)
item.description:
During the Italy summit on the 11th (local time), President Lee Jae-myung stated, "We have agreed to elevate bilateral relations to a 'Special Strategic Partnership' to reflect our determination to develop cooperation between the two countries more dynamically." (이재명 대통령이 11일(현지시각) 이탈리아 정상회담을 통해 “양국 간 협력을 더 역동적으로 발전시키겠다는 의지를 담아, 양국 관계를 ‘특별 전략적 동반자 관계’로 격상하기로 합의했다”고 말했다.)

In a joint press conference following the summit held at the Quirinal Palace in Rome, the President said, "Based on the trust and bonds accumulated so far, as well as the values shared by both countries, we will open a new chapter of cooperation toward shared prosperity." The two countries upgraded their bilateral ties from the 'Strategic Partnership' established in 2018 to a 'Special Strategic Partnership' on the occasion of this summit. This marks President Lee's first state visit to Europe since his administration took office, and it is also the first state visit by a South Korean president to Italy in 26 years since former President Kim Dae-jung. (이 대통령은 이날 로마 대통령궁에서 열린 정상회담 뒤 공동언론발표에서 “그간 축적된 신뢰와 유대, 양국이 공유하는 가치를 바탕으로 공동번영을 향한 새로운 협력의 장을 열어나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 양국은 2018년 수립한 ‘전략적 동반자 관계’를 이번 정상회담을 계기로 ‘특별 전략적 동반자 관계’로 한 단계 격상했다. 이 대통령이 정부 출범 이후 유럽을 국빈 방문한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 김대중 전 대통령 이후 26년 만에 우리 국가 정상의 이탈리아 국빈방문이기도 하다.)

President Lee stated, "We will further develop trade and investment cooperation between the two countries in a mutually beneficial manner and work together for the stable business activities of companies from both nations." He added, "In particular, the 'Memorandum of Understanding on SME Cooperation' and the 'Memorandum of Understanding on Social Solidarity Economy Cooperation' signed this time will become an important foundation for identifying practical support measures for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and small business owners, as well as revitalizing the social solidarity economy ecosystem in both countries." Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and Hyosung Group Chairman Cho Hyun-joon are expected to attend the 'Korea-Italy Business Round Table' to be held in Rome on the 12th. (이 대통령은 “양국 간 교역·투자 협력을 더욱 호혜적으로 발전시키고, 양국 기업의 안정적 경영 활동을 위해 함께 노력하겠다”며 “특히 이번에 체결되는 ‘중소기업 협력 양해각서’와 ‘사회연대경제 협력 양해각서’는 중소기업·소상공인을 위한 실질적인 지원책을 발굴하고, 양국 사회연대경제 생태계를 활성화하는 중요한 기반이 될 것”이라고 말했다. 12일 로마에서 열리는 ‘한-이탈리아 비즈니스 라운드 테이블’에는 이재용 삼성전자 회장과 조현준 효성 회장 등이 참석할 예정이다.)

Furthermore, the two countries agreed to further expand future-oriented cooperation in high-tech industries and science and technology. President Lee stated, "The 'Memorandum of Understanding on Advanced Science and Technology and ICT Cooperation' adopted this time will serve as an institutional foundation to further advance the partnership between the two countries in national strategic technology fields such as artificial intelligence, quantum industry, sixth-generation mobile communication, and advanced biotechnology." (또 첨단산업 및 과학기술 분야에서 양국의 미래지향적인 협력을 더욱 확대하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “이번에 채택하는 ‘첨단 과학기술 및 정보통신기술(ICT) 협력에 관한 양해각서‘는 인공지능, 양자산업, 6세대 이동통신, 첨단바이오 등 국가 전략기술 분야에서 양국의 파트너십을 더욱 고도화할 제도적 기반이 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

In addition, they agreed to cooperate on energy security, which has been exacerbated by the prolonged war involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. President Lee said, "Having experienced supply chain crises stemming from the recent Middle East conflicts, we keenly feel the need for cooperation among allied countries." He added, "Korea and Italy will work closely together, promoting energy security and supply chain stability through close communication and collaboration." (아울러 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 인한 에너지 안보에 대해서 협력을 해 나가기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “최근 중동 전쟁에서 비롯된 공급망 위기를 겪으며, 우리는 우방국 간 공조의 필요성을 절실히 체감하고 있다”며 “한·이탈리아 양국은 에너지 안보와 공급망 안정을 함께 도모하며 긴밀히 소통하고 협력해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding issues on the Korean Peninsula, President Lee stated, "I informed President Mattarella about our vision for peaceful coexistence and shared growth on the Korean Peninsula." He added, "The President highly appreciated our government's willingness for dialogue and cooperation and responded that we would work together for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." (이 대통령은 한반도 문제와 관련해선 “저는 마타렐라 대통령께 한반도 평화공존과 공동 성장을 위한 구상에 대해 말씀드렸다”며 “대통령님께서는 우리 정부의 대화와 협력 의지를 높이 평가하며, 한반도 평화와 안정을 위해 함께 노력하겠다고 화답해 주셨다”고 말했다.)

Rome / Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Tries to Manage with “Unity,” but Calls for “Immediate Resignation” Erupt at Party Meeting (정청래 “단결” 수습 나섰지만…의총서 “당장 사퇴” 분출)
item.description:
At the first general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers following the June 3 local elections, calls for Representative Jung Cheong-rae to resign from his leadership position erupted. Criticism also continued regarding the responsibility for the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election, as well as the rough and inadequate management of the candidate nomination process. (6·3 지방선거 뒤 처음으로 열린 더불어민주당 의원총회에서 정청래 대표를 향한 대표직 사퇴 요구가 분출했다. 서울시장 선거 패배에 대한 책임론과 함께 공천 과정 관리가 거칠고 미흡했다는 비판도 이어졌다.)

At the Democratic Party lawmakers’ meeting, which lasted about 1 hour and 10 minutes at the National Assembly on the 11th, several attendees demanded Representative Jung resign. Lawmaker Jang Cheol-min said in a Facebook post, “For genuine unity and to consolidate party strength after the national convention, you must resign, even today. This applies not only to Representative Jung but also to all those responsible for managing the national convention election.” (11일 국회에서 1시간10분가량 열린 민주당 의원총회에서 여러 참석자들은 정 대표에게 사퇴를 요구했다. 장철민 의원은 “진정으로 통합하고 전당대회 이후 당력을 결집하려면, 오늘이라도 사퇴해야 한다. 정 대표뿐만 아니라 전당대회 선거 관리의 책임을 갖고 있는 분들 모두 마찬가지”라고 말했다고 페이스북을 통해 밝혔다.)

Lawmaker Lim Mi-ae reportedly stated, “In 2024, Representative Lee Jae-myung resigned, and the election was held within 60 days, and in 2010, Representative Chung Sye-kyun resigned two months before the convention,” adding, “It is necessary to demonstrate a will to fairly manage the national convention by resigning from the leadership.” This was a strong urging to resign immediately to show commitment to a fair national convention. (임미애 의원도 “2024년 이재명 대표 사퇴 후 60일 안에 선거를 했고, 2010년 정세균 대표는 (전대) 두달 전에 사퇴했다”며 “전당대회를 공정하게 관리하겠다는 의지를 (대표직 사퇴로) 보여주는 것이 필요하다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다. 공정한 전당대회에 대한 의지를 보이려면 즉시 사퇴하라고 촉구한 것이다.)

Lawmaker Shin Jeong-hoon pointed out issues in the internal public opinion polling process for selecting candidates in the Honam region local elections. He reportedly made remarks suggesting that independent candidates performed unexpectedly well “due to the Democratic Party’s arrogant attitude toward Honam.” Lawmaker Jeong Il-young, whose constituency is Yeonsu-gu, Incheon, reportedly commented that an unqualified candidate was nominated for the Yeonsu-gu district office head election, leading to defeat, and stressed that “we must be humble.” (신정훈 의원은 호남권 지방선거 후보를 결정하기 위한 당내 여론조사 과정의 문제점을 지적했다. 그는 “호남에 대한 민주당의 오만한 자세 때문”에 무소속 후보들이 예상 외의 선전을 했다는 취지의 발언을 했다고 한다. 인천 연수을이 지역구인 정일영 의원은 부적격한 후보가 연수구청장 후보로 공천돼 선거에서 패배했다며 “겸손해야 한다”는 취지의 발언을 했다.)

In response, some voices opposed the blame on Representative Jung or emphasized unity. Lawmaker Choi Min-hee reportedly countered claims of a “major defeat” within the party, saying, “In terms of numbers (for metropolitan mayoral elections), 12 to 4 is indeed a victory.” Lawmaker Kim Young-bae reportedly stated, “This isn’t something that can be resolved by shouting and pointing fingers at each other. Properly evaluating the local elections is necessary to come up with alternatives.” (이에 맞서 정 대표 책임론에 반대하거나 통합을 강조하는 목소리도 나왔다. 최민희 의원은 “(광역단체장 선거) 12 대 4 숫자로는 승리한 것이 맞다”며 당내 일각의 ‘대패’ 주장을 반박했다고 한다. 김영배 의원은 “서로 소리를 지르고 삿대질을 한다고 될 문제가 아니다. 지방선거 평가를 제대로 해야 대안이 마련된다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Representative Jung did not give any specific response to the demands for his resignation from some lawmakers. In his opening remarks before the lawmakers’ full-fledged statements began, he called for internal unity, saying, “Throughout history, we have won when united and lost when divided.” After referencing President Lee Jae-myung’s past comment that “While politics may seem like something politicians do, it is ultimately done by the people,” Representative Jung added, “President Lee often emphasized internal unity.” (정 대표는 일부 의원들의 사퇴 요구에 별다른 답을 하지 않았다. 정 대표는 의원들의 본격적인 발언이 시작되기 전 회의 머리발언에서는 “우리는 역사 속에서 단결하며 승리했고 분열하면 패배했다”며 내부 단결을 주문했다. 또 ‘정치는 정치인이 하는 것 같지만, 결국 국민이 한다’는 이재명 대통령의 과거 발언을 언급한 뒤 “이 대통령은 내부 단결을 강조하는 말을 자주 했다”고 했다.)

At a symposium hosted by the Democratic Research Institute and the party’s policy committee titled “One Year of the Lee Jae-myung Government,” Representative Jung flattered President Lee, stating, “President Lee’s very existence has become a constant in South Korea’s national competitiveness.” This remark seemed to be a response to backlash from non-mainstream factions, following his earlier comment at the Supreme Council meeting that “no regime can win against the people. The people are eternal, and regimes are temporary.” (정 대표는 민주연구원과 당 정책위원회가 주최한 ‘이재명 정부 1년’ 토론회에선 “이 대통령 존재 자체가 대한민국 국가 경쟁력의 상수로 자리 잡았다”며 이 대통령을 추어올렸다. 정 대표의 이런 발언은 전날 최고위원회의에서 “국민 이기는 정권은 없다. 국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”고 말한 뒤 비당권파를 중심으로 ‘청와대와 각을 세우는 것이냐’는 반발을 의식한 것으로 보인다.)

On this day, Representative Jung actively refuted criticism from lawmakers like Kim Nam-hee and Jeon Hyun-hee, who had pointed out that the party’s one-member-one-vote system—which Jung had actively introduced—was causing a disconnect from public sentiment. Representative Jung wrote on Facebook, “The one-member-one-vote system is democracy itself. Democracy must be protected.” (이날 정 대표는 최근 김남희·전현희 의원 등이 정 대표가 적극적으로 도입한 권리당원 1인 1표제로 인해 당이 민심과 괴리되고 있다는 취지의 지적을 내놓는 것에 대해선 적극 반박했다. 정 대표는 페이스북에 “1인 1표제는 민주주의 그 자체”라며 “민주주의는 지켜져야 한다”고 썼다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook declares assets worth 25 billion won... 2 houses, 10.3 billion won in deposits, 2 billion won in stocks (한성숙, 재산 250억원 신고…집 2채·예금 103억·주식 20억)
item.description:
Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook has declared total assets of 25.3901 billion won, including those in her name and her mother's. (한성숙 국무총리 후보자가 본인과 어머니 명의 재산으로 모두 253억9010만6000원을 신고했다.)

According to the confirmation hearing request submitted to the National Assembly on the 11th, Han's personal assets amount to 25.00882 billion won, comprising real estate worth 3.06648 billion won, deposits of 10.32387 billion won, and stocks of 2.06583 billion won. This is an increase of 2.70725 billion won from the 22.30157 billion won declared at the end of last year. (11일 국회에 제출된 한 후보자 인사청문요청안을 보면, 한 후보자 본인 명의 재산은 부동산 30억6648만원과 예금 103억2387만원, 주식 20억6583만원 등 250억882만원이다. 지난해 말 기준 신고액 223억157만원보다 27억725만원 늘었다.)

Han is a multi-homeowner with two houses: a standalone house in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (1.5 billion won), and a standalone house in Yangseo-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province (630 million won). She also owns a 1/10 share (6.97 million won) of a standalone house in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province. Among the homes she declared as assets last year, she sold an apartment in Jamsil-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, reportedly making a profit of nearly 3 billion won after 20 years of ownership. (한 후보자는 서울 종로구 삼청동 단독주택(15억원)과 경기 양평군 양서면 단독주택(6억3천만원) 등 주택 2채를 보유한 다주택자다. 경기 양주시 광사동 단독주택의 지분 10분의 1(697만원)도 가지고 있다. 한 후보자는 지난해 재산으로 신고했던 주택 가운데 서울 송파구 잠실동 아파트는 팔았는데, 구매 20년 만에 약 30억원에 가까운 차익을 남긴 것으로 전해졌다.)

Apart from houses, Han declared ownership of an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul (approximately 2.07463 billion won), a neighborhood living facility in Yeongeon-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (approximately 1.4 billion won), a second-class neighborhood living facility (approximately 890 million won), land in Yangseo-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province, and land in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province. (한 후보자는 주택 외 부동산으로는 서울 강남구 역삼동 오피스텔(약 20억7463만원), 서울 종로구 연건동 근린생활시설(약 14억원)·제2종근린생활시설(약 8억9천만원), 경기 양평군 양서면 일대 토지와 경기 양주시 광사동 일대 토지를 갖고 있다고 신고했다.)

Her stocks were mostly foreign stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs), including Tesla (approximately 1.29457 billion won), Apple (approximately 420 million won), Palantir (approximately 120.15 million won), and Nvidia (approximately 146.09 million won). Additionally, Han declared a leasehold on an apartment in Naesu-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (1.85 billion won), government bonds (3.090552 billion won), private bonds (345 million won), and a 2011 Kia Sportage (1995cc). (주식은 테슬라(약 12억9457만원), 애플(약 4억2천만원), 팔란티어(약 1억2015만원), 엔비디아(약 1억4609만원) 등 해외 주식과 상장지수펀드(ETF)가 대부분이었다. 한 후보자는 이 밖에도 서울 종로구 내수동 아파트 전세권(18억5천만원)과 국채(30억9055만2천원), 사인 간 채권(3억4500만원), 2011년식 기아 스포티지(1995㏄) 등을 신고했다.)

Han's mother declared total assets of 381.283 million won, including land in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province (approximately 329 million won) and deposits. (한 후보자의 어머니는 경기 양주시 광사동 토지(약 3억2900만원)와 예금 등 총 3억8128만3000원의 재산을 신고했다.)

Regarding Han's criminal record, in 2006, while serving as the head of the search service division at the portal site Empas, she was fined 10 million won and ordered forfeiture for violating the Information and Communications Network Act (distribution of obscene material). At the time, prosecutors indicted dozens of people, including Han, claiming that adult content provided by the portal site was massively distributing obscene materials. On the 8th, Han's confirmation preparation team stated, "This was a case where representatives of internet portal services were all prosecuted and punished in 2005. At the time, as the overall head of Empas's search service, the nominee was punished, but it is not true that she directly posted obscene material." (한 후보자의 범죄 이력을 보면, 포털사이트 엠파스의 검색서비스본부장으로 있던 2006년 정보통신망법 위반(음란물유포 등)으로 벌금 1천만원과 몰수형을 선고받았다. 당시 검찰은 포털사이트가 제공하는 성인 콘텐츠가 음란물을 대량 유포하고 있다며 수십명을 기소했는데, 당시 한 후보자도 포함됐다. 한 후보자 인사청문준비단 지난 8일 “2005년 인터넷 포털 서비스 대표자들이 고발당하여 모두 처분을 받은 건으로, 당시 후보자는 엠파스 검색서비스 전체 책임자로서 처벌을 받은 바 있으나, 직접 음란물을 게시했다는 것은 사실이 아니다”는 입장을 냈다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Infringement of Suffrage Is Unacceptable... Zero Tolerance for Destruction of Democratic Order" (김민석 “참정권 침해 용납 안돼…민주 질서 파괴엔 무관용 대응”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 11th regarding the "ballot shortage incident," "While the infringement of suffrage is unacceptable, I also believe that the violation of democratic order must not be tolerated." (김민석 국무총리가 11일 ‘투표용지 부족사태’와 관련해 “참정권 침해도 용납할 수 없는 일이지만 민주질서 침해 또한 용납되어선 안 된다 생각한다”고 말했다.)

At a meeting of ministers related to the infringement of citizens' suffrage held at the Government Complex Sejong in Sejong City, Prime Minister Kim said, "By what right do they block citizens' free movement or access, detain police officers, and slander and hurl insults at passing citizens? Who has the right to do such things?" (김 총리는 이날 세종시 정부세종청사에서 열린 국민참정권 침해 관련 관계장관회의에서 “무슨 권리로 시민들의 자유로운 통행이나 출입을 막고 경찰관들을 감금하고 또 지나가는 시민을 비방하고 욕설하고 그렇게 할 권리가 누구에게 있냐”며 이같이 말했다.)

This was a criticism of problematic actions by some participants who have been blocking the entrance to the Handball Stadium at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu for a week and holding protest rallies, including stopping female youth national handball team players from entering and searching their belongings. On that day, some protesters also blocked a press conference by employees of resident sports organizations trying to enter the stadium and hurled abusive language and threats at the press. (이는 일주일째 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 입구를 봉쇄하고 규탄 시위를 벌이는 참가자 가운데 일부가 핸드볼 여성 유소년 국가대표 선수들의 출입을 막고 소지품을 뒤지는 등 문제 행동을 이어가는 것에 대해 지적한 것이다. 이날 일부 시위 참가자들은 경기장에 진입하려는 입주 체육단체 직원들의 기자회견을 가로막고 취재진에게 욕설과 폭언을 쏟아내기도 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim said, "Exploiting the public demand to protect democracy to instead destroy democratic order and democracy is absolutely unacceptable," adding, "I ask relevant ministries to respond with the principle of zero tolerance, thoroughly investigating to ensure such acts never happen." He continued, "Responsibility must be taken for the infringement of suffrage, but responsibility must also be taken for the violation of democratic order. The government will humbly accept legitimate questions and discussions, but will respond strictly and consistently to anti-democratic behavior that causes inconvenience to citizens." (김 총리는 “민주주의를 지켜야 한다는 국민 요구를 악용해서 오히려 민주질서와 민주주의를 파괴하려는 행위는 절대로 용납될 수 없다”며 “무관용의 원칙으로 끝까지 파악하고 절대로 그런 일이 이뤄질 수 없도록 해야 한다는 생각으로 관련 부처는 대응해달라”고 말했다. 그는 “참정권 침해에 대해서도 책임져야 하지만 민주질서 침해도 반드시 책임을 져야 할 것”이라며 “정부는 정당한 문제제기와 논의에 대해서는 겸허한 자세로 수용하겠지만 시민들에게 불편을 끼치는 반민주적 행태에 대해서는 끝까지 원칙적으로 대응하겠다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission, which has revealed comprehensive disarray, Prime Minister Kim said, "If this is the case, wouldn't it be better to dissolve the commission? There must be voices from the public saying the commission should be dissolved if it operates like this." He added, "I believe a thorough awakening is needed from the top to the bottom." (김 총리는 총체적 난맥상이 드러나고 있는 중앙선거관리위원회에 대해서도 “이럴 거면 선관위는 차라리 해체하는 게 낫지 않나, 선관위가 이런 식이면 해체돼야 한다는 국민 목소리가 틀림없이 있다”고 말했다. 그는 “정말 위부터 아래까지 대오각성해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Addressing the National Assembly, Prime Minister Kim said, "Beyond factions or political interests, I ask the ruling and opposition parties to quickly discuss forming a special committee to strengthen democracy, lead a thorough investigation into the truth, and discuss institutional improvements. The government will actively cooperate in all necessary areas." (김 총리는 국회를 향해서도 “정파나 정치적 이해관계를 떠나 여야가 민주주의 공고화를 위해 특위 구성을 신속하게 협의해주시고 철저한 진상규명과 제도개선 논의를 이끌어주시기 바란다”며 “정부도 필요한 모든 부분 적극 협력하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ko Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Following Jeonbuk, Gyeonggi Election Commission Also Admits Vote Counting Error… Seoul Violated Regulations with Unnumbered Ballot Papers (전북 이어 경기 선관위도 개표 오류…서울, 무번호 투표지 규정 위반)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC)’s overall disarray, exposed by the “ballot paper shortage” incident, has now revealed that in the Gyeonggi Superintendent of Education election held on the 3rd, a staff member incorrectly entered the vote count results, belatedly coming to light on the 11th. Following the discovery of a vote count input error in the Jeonbuk Superintendent of Education election the previous day, controversy over the NEC’s management failures is spreading like wildfire. Prime Minister Kim Min-seok warned, “The NEC must wake up from top to bottom.” (선거관리위원회(선관위)의 총체적 난맥상이 ‘투표용지 부족’ 사태를 계기로 드러난 가운데 지난 3일 치러진 경기교육감 선거에서도 담당자가 개표 결과를 잘못 입력한 사실이 11일 뒤늦게 드러났다. 전날 전북교육감 선거에 이어 개표 결과 입력 오류가 추가로 발견되면서 선관위의 관리 부실 논란이 일파만파 확산하는 모양새다. 김민석 국무총리는 “선관위가 위부터 아래까지 대오각성해야 한다”고 경고했다.)

The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission issued a public apology today, stating that an error occurred in the vote count input for the Gyeonggi Superintendent of Education election. Unlike other public office elections, the Superintendent election has no candidate symbols, so the order on the ballot paper is determined by lottery, and ballot papers are divided into Type A and Type B for processing. The error occurred because polling stations using Type B ballot papers were mistakenly entered in the vote counting report system as if they were Type A, which is the default order. (경기도선관위는 이날 대국민 사과문을 내어 경기교육감 선거에서 득표수 입력 오류가 발생했다고 밝혔다. 교육감 선거는 다른 공직선거와 달리 기호가 없어 추첨을 통해 투표용지 게재 순위를 결정하고 투표용지를 에이(A)형과 비(B)형으로 나눠 처리하는데, 비형 투표용지를 사용한 투표소가 개표보고시스템의 기본 순위인 에이형인 것처럼 잘못 입력했다는 것이다.)

The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission explained that the vote count input error occurred at the 3rd polling station in Geumgwang 2-dong, Jungwon-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province. Using Type B ballot papers, the candidate order should have been Ahn Min-seok followed by Lim Tae-hee, but the vote count was entered in reverse order as Lim Tae-hee followed by Ahn Min-seok. Initially, the Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission publicly announced that candidate Ahn received 368 votes and candidate Lim received 337 votes, but the accurate count was 337 votes for Ahn and 368 votes for Lim. (득표수 입력 오류가 발생한 곳은 경기 성남시 중원구 금광2동 제3투표소로, 비형 투표용지를 사용해 후보자 순서가 안민석-임태희 후보 순이었으나, 임태희-안민석 후보 순서로 개표 결과를 바꿔 입력했다고 경기도선관위는 설명했다. 경기도선관위는 애초 안 후보가 368표, 임 후보가 337표를 득표했다고 공표했는데, 정확한 개표 결과는 안 후보 337표, 임 후보 368표였다.)

Another incorrect vote count input case was discovered at the 2nd polling station in Chowol-eup, Gwangju-si, Gyeonggi Province. A polling officer mistakenly entered the results from the 9th polling station in Chowol-eup as those of the 2nd polling station, resulting in a false announcement of 582 votes for Ahn and 668 votes for Lim. After correction, the announced vote counts were revised to 798 votes for Ahn and 869 votes for Lim. Following the correction of the input errors at these two polling stations, the total votes for the two candidates changed from 3,557,171 votes for Ahn and 3,178,132 votes for Lim to 3,557,356 votes for Ahn and 3,178,364 votes for Lim. (경기 광주시 초월읍 제2투표소에서도 개표 결과 오입력 사례가 발견됐다. 개표사무원이 초월읍 제9투표소를 제2투표소로 잘못 입력하면서 안 후보 582표, 임 후보 668표로 잘못 입력돼 공표된 득표수는 안 후보 798표, 임 후보 869표로 수정됐다. 투표소 2곳에서 잘못 입력된 득표수를 바로잡은 결과, 두 후보의 득표수는 안 후보 355만7171표, 임 후보 317만8132표에서 안 후보 355만7356표, 임 후보 317만8364표로 바뀌었다.)

In the case of the incorrect polling log entry at the 3rd polling station in Junghwasan 1-dong, Wansan-gu, Jeonju-si, Jeonbuk, revealed through media reports the previous day, it was found that the Wansan-gu Election Commission, which oversees it, confirmed the error in the early hours of the 4th, when vote counting was ongoing, but only belatedly reported it to the Jeonbuk Provincial Election Commission chairperson on the morning of the 9th. The Jeonbuk Provincial Election Commission also issued a public apology, stating, “We will improve the polling log creation system and revise regulations, including guidelines to prevent errors in vote count input.” (전날 언론 보도로 드러난 전북 전주시 완산구 중화산1동 제3투표소의 투표록 오입력 사례의 경우, 이를 관할하는 완산구선관위가 개표가 진행되던 지난 4일 새벽 오류를 확인했지만 9일 오전에야 전북도선관위원장에게 늑장 보고한 것으로 파악됐다. 전북도선관위도 대국민 사과문을 내어 “투표록 작성 시스템 개선, 개표 결과 입력 오류 방지를 위한 지침 등 규정을 정비하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the Central Election Commission’s Fact-Finding Committee on the ballot paper shortage incident announced that during the June 3 local elections, the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission distributed unnumbered ballot papers uniformly as ‘2,000 per district’, contrary to internal guidelines stipulating distribution of ‘about 3% of the number of voters in each district’. Consequently, fewer unnumbered ballot papers were distributed than the standard. (한편 중앙선관위 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회는 6·3 지방선거 당시 서울시선관위가 내부 지침상 ‘자치구 선거인 수의 3% 내외’로 배부해야 할 무번호 투표용지를 ‘자치구당 2천개’로 통일해 배부하면서, 무번호 투표용지도 기준보다 적게 배부됐다고 밝혔다.)

Chairman of the NEC Fact-Finding Committee, Jo Hyeon-wook, held a briefing today at the Central Election Commission in Gwacheon-si, Gyeonggi Province, stating, “The Public Official Election Procedure Manual stipulates that unnumbered ballot papers should be printed at about 3% above the number of voters registered in the electoral register. However, in this local election, the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission issued a guideline for its district, city, and county election commissions to print only 2,000 sheets.” He added, “Taking Songpa-gu as an example, with 564,438 voters, applying the 3% rule would require distributing about 17,000 unnumbered ballot papers, but only 2,000 were distributed.” Chairman Jo further noted, “There was also no manual for assigning serial numbers to unnumbered ballot papers, causing confusion and serious delays in election procedures during the serial number allocation process.” (조현욱 선관위 진상규명위원장은 이날 경기 과천시 중앙선관위에서 브리핑을 열어 “무번호 투표용지는 선거인 명부에 등재된 선거인 수의 3% 내외에서 가산해 인쇄하도록 공직선거절차 사무편람에 규정돼 있다. 그러나 이번 지방선거에서 서울시선관위는 관내 구·시·군선관위에 2천장을 인쇄하도록 지침을 하달했다”며 “송파구를 예로 들면, 선거인 수가 56만4438명이기 때문에 3%를 적용하면 약 1만7천장의 무번호 투표용지가 교부돼야 하는데 2천장만 교부됐다”고 밝혔다. 조 위원장은 “무번호 투표용지의 일련번호 작성 관련 매뉴얼도 부존재해, 일련번호를 부여받는 과정에서 혼란과 선거 절차 지연이 심각하게 발생했다”고 덧붙였다.)

In response, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok instructed at a meeting of ministers related to the infringement of citizens’ political rights held that evening at the Government Complex Sejong, “Focus on the joint investigation headquarters to conduct a swift and strict investigation.” (이에 김민석 총리는 이날 저녁 정부세종청사에서 한 국민 참정권 침해 관련 관계장관회의에서 “합동수사본부 중심으로 해서 최대한 신속하고 엄정하게 수사하라”고 지시했다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government “Launches Public Debate Centered on Youth and University Students to Prevent Recurrence of ‘NEC Incident’” (정부 “‘선관위 사태’ 재발 방지 위해 청년·대학생 중심 공론화 착수”)
item.description:
The government announced on the 11th that it will conduct a swift investigation into the mismanagement of ballot handling by the National Election Commission (NEC), led by the joint investigation headquarters of the prosecution and police, while also initiating a social public debate centered on youth and university students to prevent recurrence. (정부가 11일 선거관리위원회의 부실 투표 관리에 대해 검·경 합수본을 중심으로 신속한 수사에 들어가는 한편, 재발방지를 위해 청년·대학생을 중심으로 사회적 공론화에 착수하기로 했다.)

After convening a ‘Meeting of Ministers Related to Infringement of Citizens’ Voting Rights’ presided over by Prime Minister Kim Min-seok at the Government Complex Sejong in Sejong City on the evening of the same day, the government stated, “We have decided to take all possible measures, including cooperation with a parliamentary audit, to uncover the truth behind this infringement of citizens’ voting rights and to reform the NEC,” and added, “We have resolved to conduct a swift and thorough investigation centered on the joint investigation headquarters of the prosecution and police, ensuring no suspicions of oversight or omissions.” (정부는 이날 저녁 김민석 국무총리 주재로 세종시 정부세종청사에서 ‘국민참정권 침해 관련 관계장관회의’를 연 뒤 “이번 국민참정권 침해 사태에 대한 진상규명과 선관위 개혁을 위해 국정조사 협조 등 가능한 모든 조치를 다하기로 했다”며 “검·경합수본을 중심으로 한 치의 의혹도 없도록 최대한 신속하고 철저하게 수사하기로 했다고 했다”고 발표했다.)

Regarding the intensifying protests blocking the vote counting station at Seoul’s Jamsil Olympic Park, the government indicated a strong response. The government stated, “While we respect and actively protect legitimate expressions of opinion, we will swiftly investigate and sternly address clear illegal acts, such as assaults, defamation, and coercion against citizens, journalists, and police.” (격해지는 서울 잠실 올림픽 공원 내 개표소 봉쇄 시위에 대해서는 강력하게 대응할 뜻을 밝혔다. 정부는 “정당한 의사표현에 대해서는 존중하고 적극 보호하되, 시민·기자·경찰 등에 대한 폭행·명예훼손·강요 등 명백한 불법행위에 대해서는 신속하게 수사하여 엄중 조치하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Furthermore, to prevent recurrence of the incident, the government said it will begin social discussions and consensus-building with young people. (아울러 사태 재발 방지를 위해 청년들과 사회적 논의와 합의를 시작하겠다고 했다.)

The government announced, “We will launch a public debate centered on youth and university students, including the 17 university student groups that issued a joint declaration on the state of affairs.” (정부는 “공동시국선언을 한 17개 대학 학생 단체를 포함하여 청년·대학생을 중심으로 공론화에 착수하겠다”고 발표했다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Investigation Launched Into Allegations of Forced Drinking Leading to Firefighter's Death: 'We Will Reveal Everything Clearly' (‘소방관 음주 강요 사망 의혹’ 국조실 조사 착수…“명명백백 밝힐 것”)
item.description:
The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced on the 11th that it will begin a full investigation into allegations that a female firefighter from the Gwangju Metropolitan Fire Safety Headquarters died due to a coercive drinking culture and workplace abuse. (국무조정실은 광주광역시 소방안전본부 소속 여성 소방관이 직장 내 강압적 음주 문화와 갑질 탓에 숨졌다는 의혹에 대해 본격 조사에 착수한다고 11일 밝혔다.)

In a press release issued the same day, the Office for Government Policy Coordination stated, "Considering the gravity of the matter, we will swiftly investigate, as thoroughly as possible, issues such as forced drinking and whether the family's request for an inspection was ignored, to ensure that the president's instructions are fully implemented and to clearly reveal the factual truth." Earlier, President Lee Jae-myung posted on his X (formerly Twitter) account a link to an article about the firefighter's death, saying, "If the investigation confirms forced drinking and the dismissal of the inspection request, we will impose the maximum possible punishment, including disciplinary action, criminal penalties, civil damages, and even claims for reimbursement, so that malignant workplace abuse like forced drinking at company dinners, or the cover-up and neglect of corruption, can never even be imagined in this country again." (국무조정실은 이날 보도자료를 내어 “사안의 중대성을 고려해 대통령 지시 사항이 철저히 이행될 수 있도록 음주 강요, 유가족의 감찰 조사 요구 묵살 여부 등을 최대한 신속히 조사해 사실 관계를 명명백백하게 밝힐 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 앞서 이재명 대통령은 이날 자신의 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 소방관 사망 기사를 링크하며 “조사 결과 음주 강요, 감찰 조사 요구 묵살이 사실로 드러나면 징계는 물론 형사 처벌에 민사 손해배상 후 구상 청구까지 할 수 있는 최대치의 문책을 해서, 다시는 이 나라에서 회식 음주 강요 같은 직장 내 악성 갑질이나 부정부패 은폐·묵살은 꿈도 꿀 수 없게 하겠다”고 말했다.)

According to the media report linked by President Lee, the Gwangju Fire Headquarters stated in an official document last October that the cause of death of a female firefighter in her 20s, identified as Ms. A, who took her own life, was related to 'issues with her fiancé.' In response, Ms. A's fiancé, Mr. B, requested an inspection based on text messages in which Ms. A had complained about the coercive drinking and dinner culture at work. However, it is reported that the headquarters delayed the inspection for over five months, only launching it after Mr. B and the bereaved family visited the higher authority, the National Fire Agency. (이 대통령이 링크한 언론 보도를 보면, 광주소방본부는 지난해 10월 20대 여성 소방관 ㄱ씨가 스스로 목숨을 끊은 사건에 대해, 고인의 사망 원인을 ‘약혼자의 관계’ 문제라고 공문에 적시했다고 한다. 이에 ㄱ씨의 약혼자 ㄴ씨는 ㄱ씨가 생전 직장 내 강압적 회식·음주 문화 등으로 어려움을 호소했던 문자 메시지 등을 근거로 감찰을 요구했다. 그러나 본부는 5개월 넘게 감찰을 미루다, ㄴ씨와 유족이 상급기관이 소방청을 방문하고 나서야 감찰에 착수한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Firefighters' Union also held a press conference in front of Gwangju City Hall on the same day, claiming that the deceased had suffered from excessive drinking and dinner culture, as well as orders for personal errands. According to KakaoTalk messages from Ms. A released on that day, she expressed distress, writing, "This place is crazy. They drink so fast. As soon as I arrived, I had to down four shots of soju and beer mix." She also wrote, "(A superior) wants us to go to a noraebang (karaoke) together." The Firefighters' Union urged, "Conduct a thorough and independent investigation into the death, and have the headquarters chief officially apologize for secondary victimization, as well as implement effective measures to eradicate workplace abuse." (소방공무원노동조합도 이날 광주시청 앞에서 기자회견을 열어 고인이 생전 과도한 음주·회식문화, 사적 심부름 지시 등에 시달렸다고 주장했다. 이날 공개된 ㄱ씨의 카카오톡 메시지를 보면, ㄱ씨는 “여기 미쳤다. 술을 너무 빨리 마신다. 오자마자 소맥(소주+맥주) 4잔 원샷” “(상급자가) 둘이 노래방에 가자고 한다”며 곤혹스러워하는 내용이 담겨있다. 소방노조는 “사망 사건에 대한 철저하고 독립적인 조사를 실시하고, 2차 가해 행위에 대한 본부장의 공식 사과와 실효성 있는 갑질 근절 대책을 마련하라”고 촉구했다.)

Reporter Choi Hye-jung, idun@hani.co.kr (최혜정 기자 idun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Italy awards President Lee ‘highest order of merit’… Eurofighter escort flight also provided (이탈리아, 이 대통령에게 ‘최고 등급 훈장’ 수여… 유로파이터 호위 비행도)
item.description:
President Sergio Mattarella will award President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Italy on the 12th (local time), the ‘Knight Grand Cross of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic’, the highest order for foreign heads of state. (세르지오 마타렐라 대통령이 12일(현지시각) 이탈리아를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령에게 외국 정상에 대한 최고 등급 훈장인 ‘이탈리아 공화국 기사대십자 공로훈장’을 수여한다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Yoo-jung announced this during a briefing at the press center set up in downtown Rome, stating, “This signifies an evaluation of President Lee’s contributions to enhancing friendly relations between South Korea and Italy, and an expression of the highest level of respect.” This marks the first order President Lee has received from a foreign government since taking office. ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 로마 시내에 마련된 프레스센터에서 열린 브리핑에서 이 같이 밝히며 “이는 한국과 이탈리아의 우호관계를 증진시킨 이 대통령의 기여를 평가하고, 최고 수준의 예우를 표명한다는 의미를 갖고 있다”고 말했다. 이번 훈장은 이 대통령이 취임 뒤 외국 정부로부터 받는 최초의 훈장이다. )

The Knight Grand Cross of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic, awarded to President Lee, is Italy’s highest order established by law on March 3, 1951. It is presented to Italian citizens or foreign heads of state who have made outstanding contributions to national prestige in fields such as science, arts, economy, and public service. A Cheong Wa Dae official said, “The Speaker of the House also emphasized South Korea’s high importance in international relations, noting that President Lee has held three meetings with Prime Minister Meloni since taking office. This order seems to reflect both expectations for his role and an evaluation of it.” ( 이 대통령이 수여받은 이탈리아 공화국 기사대십자 공로훈장은 1951년 3월3일 법률에 의해 제정된 이탈리아의 최고 등급 훈장이다. 과학, 예술, 경제, 공직수행 등 다양한 분야에서 국권 신장에 현저한 공로가 있는 이탈리아인 또는 국가원수급 외국인에게 수여된다. 청와대 관계자는 “취임 뒤 멜로니 총리와 세 번에 걸친 만남을 갖는 등 국제관계에 있어서 한국의 중요성이 매우 높다고 하원의장도 강조한 바 있다”며 “그런 부분에서 역할을 기대하고, 또 역할을 평가하는 훈장이라고 할 것 같다”고 말했다. )

Italy paid special attention to protocol, as this visit marks the first state visit by a South Korean president to Italy in 26 years. The previous day, as Air Force One carrying President Lee entered Italian airspace, Italy had two of its Air Force Eurofighter jets escort from both sides. President Lee said on X (formerly Twitter) that day (local time), “This honor is not for me personally, but for South Korea and its people.” ( 이탈리아는 이번 방문이 대한민국 대통령으로 26년 만의 국빈 방문인 만큼 의전에도 각별히 신경을 쏟았다. 전날 이탈리아는 이 대통령이 탑승한 공군 1호기가 이탈리아 영공에 진입하자 이탈리아 공군이 보유한 유로파이터 2대를 각각 좌우 양옆에 호위 비행하게 했다. 이 대통령은 이날(현지시각) 엑스에 “이재명에 대한 예우가 아니라 대한민국 그리고 대한민국 국민에 대한 예우”라고 말했다. )

Meanwhile, the Italian side also invited business figures to the state dinner held at the Quirinal Palace in Rome on that day. The invited business leaders include 13 individuals such as Ryu Jin, Chairman of the Federation of Korean Industries; Lee Jae-yong, Chairman of Samsung Electronics; Koo Ja-eun, Chairman of LS Group; Cho Hyun-joon, Chairman of Hyosung Group; and Kim Jung-soo, Chairman of Samyang Foods. ( 한편 이탈리아 쪽은 이날 로마 대통령궁에서 열린 국빈 만찬에 경제인사들도 초청했다. 초청받는 경제 인사는 류진 한국경제인협회 회장, 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 구자은 엘에스(LS)그룹 회장, 조현준 효성그룹 회장, 삼양식품 김정수 회장 등 13명이다. )

Rome/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Chair Video Conference in Rome, Discuss Follow-up to Election Commission Incident (이 대통령, 로마서 ‘화상회의’ 주재… 선관위 사태 후속 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a state visit to Italy, will chair a video conference with senior advisors at 2:00 p.m. local time on the 14th (9:00 p.m. KST), and plans to review the follow-up situation regarding the shortage of ballot papers at the National Election Commission. (이탈리아를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 오는 14일 오후 2시(한국시간 오후 9시) 화상 수석보좌관 회의를 개최하고, 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태 후속 상황 등을 챙길 예정이다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung stated during a briefing at the press center set up in downtown Rome on the 12th, "President Lee will directly chair the senior advisors meeting through video conference from Italy to prevent any gaps in state affairs during his overseas trip and will receive reports on key national issues." President Lee has been on a European tour since the 9th, a 10-day, 8-night schedule, with the intention of closely managing domestic affairs to ensure no disruption to state operations. ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 12일 로마 시내에 마련된 프레스센터에서 열린 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 순방 기간 중 국정 운영의 공백을 없애기 위해 이탈리아 현지에서 직접 (화상으로) 수석보좌관 회의를 주재하고 주요 국정 현안에 대해 보고받을 예정”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 지난 9일부터 8박10일 일정으로 유럽 순방 중인데, 국정 운영에 차질이 없도록 국내 현안도 세밀히 챙기겠다는 취지다.)

The upcoming video conference is expected to cover reports and discussions on: △ Plans for a parliamentary investigation into the Election Commission and institutional improvement (Office of Political Affairs), △ Launch and status of the joint prosecution-police investigation headquarters regarding the ballot paper shortage incident (Office of Civil Affairs), and △ Trends in foreign exchange and financial markets and measures for price management (Office of Economic Growth). ( 이번 화상회의에서는 △선관위 국정조사 및 제도개선 추진계획(정무수석실) △투표용지 부족 사태 관련 검·경 합동수사본부 발족 및 상황(민정수석실) △외환·금융시장 동향 및 물가관리 대책(경제성장수석실) 등을 보고하고 논의할 예정이다.)

Additionally, President Lee, who is set to return on the 18th, has also scheduled a senior advisors meeting for the following day, the 19th. Although the president's weekly senior advisors meeting is typically held on Thursdays, this one will take place on Friday to accommodate the return date. Senior Spokesperson Kang noted, "The meeting's agenda will focus on reviewing the response system for summer natural disasters. President Lee plans to prioritize people's livelihoods and public safety immediately upon his return." ( 또 오는 18일 귀국하는 이 대통령은 다음 날인 19일에도 수석보좌관 회의를 소집했다. 통상 대통령 주재 수석보좌관 회의는 목요일에 열리지만, 귀국 날짜를 고려해 금요일에 열겠다는 것이다. 강 수석대변인은 “회의 주제는 여름철 자연재해 대응 체계 점검”이라며 “이 대통령은 귀국 즉시 민생과 국민 안전을 1순위로 챙길 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Rome/ Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Seoul’s Youth in Their 20s and 30s: “A Judgment on Insurrection? We Voted to Evaluate Government Performance” (서울 2030 청년 “내란심판? 국정평가 투표했다”)
item.description:
<<>> ()

Following the June 3 local elections, attention is focused on the voting patterns and political orientations of those in their 20s and 30s. This is because in Seoul, the most hotly contested battleground of the local elections, the 2030 demographic has emerged as swing voters. They also led a rally that began at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul, protesting the shortage of ballot papers. What motivated these young people to head to the polls and the protest sites? The Hankyoreh commissioned Human & Data to conduct a Focus Group Interview (FGI) on the 10th with 14 young people in their 20s and 30s residing in Seoul, held in Yeongdeungpo-gu, to capture their thoughts “as they are.” <<> Most of the 2030 participants in the focus group expressed that they “could not relate” to the ruling party’s slogan of “judgment on insurrection,” viewing the local elections instead as an evaluation of the first year of the Lee Jae-myung government. Park Ji-hoon (pseudonym, 28, male), a resident of Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul, said, “The martial law declaration was a year and a half ago. The judgment on insurrection was for last year’s presidential election. Didn’t the Democratic Party take the lead in running state affairs? This election was an evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung government.” <<> Regarding the results of the Seoul mayoral election, participants assessed that Won Oh-jung, the Democratic Party candidate, lagged behind People Power Party winner Oh Se-hoon in terms of “personality appeal,” and that the election campaign to overcome this was insufficient. Oh Ji-eun (30, female), who voted for candidate Won, said, “Mayor Oh Se-hoon has run five times (for Seoul mayor), but I didn’t know much about his achievements, so I voted for candidate Won. Although they said candidate Won is competent, I think they failed to clearly explain what he did well.” <<> The focus group participants unanimously said of the 2030 crowd that gathered at the rally in Olympic Park, Songpa-gu, Seoul, triggered by the ballot paper shortage, that “they seemed to have come together with a sense that democracy must be protected.” Yoon Jung-hoon (38, male) questioned, “Does it make sense for a country like ours that people can’t vote because they ran out of ballot papers?” Jeong Yoo-jin (25, female) added, “It’s about being angry at the flawed election. Having been through two impeachments, I think people gathered with the mindset that democracy must be protected.” <<> The “June 3 Local Elections Evaluation Focus Group Interview (FGI) Session” was held on the 10th at an office in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, commissioned by The Hankyoreh from the pollster Human & Data. Considering the voting tendencies of the 2030 generation, the session selected 14 participants: 7 male and female voters in their 20s and 7 voters in their 30s, all living in Seoul. They were divided into two groups (20s and 30s) and held an open discussion for one hour and 30 minutes on the results of the Seoul mayoral election and the ballot paper shortage incident. <<> Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: What Divided the 20s and 30s Voter Sentiment in Seoul? "Unstable Monthly Rent... Real Estate Issues More than Stocks" (서울 ‘2030 표심’ 무엇이 갈랐나 “월세 불안…주식보다 부동산 이슈”)
item.description:
<<>> "It’s already been a year and a half since the martial law declaration. I think the election to judge the insurrection was up until the last presidential election, and this local election felt more like a midterm evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (Park Ji-hoon, 28, male, all names are pseudonyms hereafter) ()

"Candidate Jung Won-oh did announce he was the 'Myung-pick' (Lee Jae-myung's choice), but he seemed to lack recognition. In contrast, Candidate Oh Se-hoon carried the weight of a fourth-term candidate." (Lim Min-soo, 34, male) (“계엄이 벌써 1년 반이 지났잖아요. 내란 심판 선거는 직전 대선까지였다고 생각하고요, 이번 지방선거는 이재명 정부 중간평가 성격이 강했다고 봅니다.”(박지훈·이하 모두 가명·28·남))

These were the words of young Seoulites in their 20s and 30s who participated in a focus group interview (FGI) on the evaluation of the June 3 local elections, jointly conducted by *The Hankyoreh* and the polling agency Human & Data on the 10th. They said this local election was more of a 'midterm evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration' than a 'judgment of the insurrection,' and that the deciding factor for young voters in the Seoul mayoral election was more about the 'candidates' than the party. They added that 'real estate' issues had a greater impact on their voting decisions than the stock market rise, which the ruling party touted as a key achievement. ( “정원오 후보는 ‘명픽’(이재명의 선택)임을 알리긴 했지만 인지도가 떨어지는 느낌이었다면, 오세훈 후보는 4선의 무게감이 있었죠.”(임민수·34·남))

■ "'Judgment of the Insurrection' Didn't Resonate... This Election Felt Like a Midterm Evaluation" ( 지난 10일 ‘한겨레’와 여론조사업체 휴먼앤데이터가 함께 실시한 ‘6·3 지방선거 평가 표적집단 심층면접(FGI)’ 좌담회에 참여한 서울 거주 20~30대 청년들의 말이다. 이들은 이번 지방선거가 ‘내란 심판’보다는 ‘이재명 정부 중간평가’의 성격이 강했고, 서울시장 선거에서 청년층 표심을 가른 건 당보다는 ‘인물’의 차이가 컸다고 했다. 이들은 정부·여당이 주요 국정 성과로 내세운 주가 상승보다는 ‘부동산’ 이슈가 자신들의 표심에 더 영향을 미쳤다고 했다. )

The young voters in their 20s and 30s said they "didn't really resonate" with the ruling party's key slogan of 'judgment of the insurrection.' They argued that the 'judgment' for the December 3 martial law insurrection, which happened over a year and a half ago, was a matter for last year's presidential election, and this election, being the first nationwide vote since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, felt more like a midterm evaluation of the government and the ruling party. Many commented that the People Power Party's loss in most metropolitan mayoral races was due to a "decline in trust in the party itself." ( ■ “‘내란 심판’ 공감 안 가…이번 선거는 이재명 정부 중간평가 성격”)

"I think the Democratic Party of Korea tried to push the 'insurrection' keyword and ran their campaign on a judgment-of-the-insurrection platform. But honestly, the Democratic Party has had the upper hand ever since the martial law announcement. This election wasn't about judging the insurrection; it was more of a midterm evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (Park Ji-hoon) ( 2030 청년들은 여당이 이번 선거 핵심 구호 가운데 하나로 내세운 ‘내란 심판’에는 “공감이 잘 가지 않았다”고 했다. 이미 1년 반이 지난 12·3 비상계엄 내란 사태의 ‘심판’은 지난해 대선까지의 얘기이고, 이번 선거는 이재명 정부가 출범한 뒤 첫 전국 단위 선거였던 만큼 정부·여당을 중간평가하는 성격이 강했다는 것이다. 이들은 국민의힘이 다수 광역단체장 선거에서 패한 것은 “당 자체의 신뢰도가 떨어졌기 때문”이라는 이야기를 많이 했다.)

"President Lee Jae-myung is a strong leader, so he likely wanted people who share his views. The election results seemed to come from a clash between whether to support that or check his power." (Lim Min-soo) ( “더불어민주당이 ‘내란’ 키워드를 끌고 가려고 내란 심판을 내세운 선거운동을 했다고 생각해요. 사실 계엄 뒤부턴 민주당이 주도권을 잡은 지 오래잖아요. 이번 선거는 내란 심판이 아니라 이재명 정부 중간평가 성격이 강했죠.”(박지훈))

■ 'Candidate-centric' Factor That Decided the Seoul Mayoral Election ( “이재명 대통령은 리더십이 강한 사람이고 그래서 자기와 같은 의견을 가진 사람들이 필요했을 텐데, 그걸 밀어줄 건지 견제할 건지가 부딪치는 과정에서 이번 선거 결과가 나온 거 같아요.”(임민수))

Participants expressed the view that what divided young voters in the Seoul mayoral election was the 'candidate' rather than the 'party.' They noted that compared to Oh Se-hoon, the four-term incumbent Seoul mayor and presidential hopeful from the People Power Party, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, had significantly lower name recognition and gravitas. Although some participants highlighted that Jung was a 'capable candidate,' they said it was unclear exactly how he planned to perform well. Regarding President Lee's so-called 'Myung-pick'—where he praised Jung on social media before the election—opinions were divided. Some felt Jung failed to properly promote this endorsement, while others believed it actually worked against him. ( ■ 서울시장 선거 승패 가른 ‘인물론’)

"Oh Se-hoon is a four-term mayor and a presidential-level figure, while Jung Won-oh's name recognition seems too low. Only people who follow the news and are interested know he was the Seongdong-gu district mayor; those who aren't interested just think, 'Who is Jung Won-oh?'" (Yoon Jeong-hoon, 38, male) ( 참석자들은 서울시장 선거에서 젊은 층의 표심을 가른 건 ‘당’이 아닌 ‘인물’이라는 의견을 내놨다. 4선 현역 서울시장에 대선 주자로 꼽히는 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보에 견줘 정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보의 인지도와 중량감이 많이 떨어졌다는 것이다. 일부 참석자는 정 후보가 ‘일 잘하는 후보’라는 점을 부각했지만, 구체적으로 그가 어떻게 일을 잘하겠다는 것인지 잘 알 수가 없었다고 했다. 이재명 대통령이 선거 전 에스엔에스(SNS)에서 정 후보를 칭찬한 이른바 ‘명픽’에 대해서는 정 후보가 이를 제대로 홍보하지 못했다는 평가와, 오히려 정 후보에게 불리하게 작용했다는 평가로 갈렸다.)

"I voted for Jung Won-oh. I found out about him because the president said he's a 'capable person,' but when I tried to see what exactly he did well, it wasn't obvious. I think the Democratic Party should have been more proactive in promoting him." (Oh Ji-eun, 30, female) ( “오세훈은 4선이고 대선급 후보인 데 비해 정원오가 인지도가 너무 떨어진 게 아닌가 싶어요. 뉴스 좀 보고 관심 있는 사람들이나 정원오가 성동구청장 한 걸 알지, 관심 없는 사람들은 ‘정원오 누구지’ 하는 거죠.”(윤정훈·38·남))

"I wasn't familiar with Candidate Jung Won-oh. In the past, Democratic Party candidates for Seoul mayor were people I had heard of, like Song Young-gil or Park Young-sun..." (Park Ji-hoon) ( “저는 정원오를 뽑았는데요. 대통령이 ‘일 잘한다’고 하길래 알게 됐는데, 정작 뭘 잘했는지 보려고 하면 눈에 잘 안 들어오더라고요. 민주당이 더 홍보를 적극적으로 해야 했다고 생각해요.”(오지은·30·여))

"I think the 'Myung-pick' actually had a negative effect on Candidate Jung. President Lee Jae-myung is a forceful driver, and I think many people felt the need to check his power. The president is human, so he can't be 100% right all the time; he needs people to tell him that." (Shin Ji-hyun, 38, female) ( “정원오 후보가 생소했어요. 과거 민주당에서 서울시장 선거 후보로 나왔던 사람들은 송영길, 박영선처럼 이름을 들어본 적 있는 사람들이었는데….”(박지훈))

"I think it's good that the president communicates actively on social media. But with posts like the one about Starbucks—private companies shouldn't be subject to state sanctions like that... Don't you think that might have affected the election too?" (Lee Min-joon, 27, male) ( “‘명픽’이 오히려 정 후보한텐 부정적이었던 거 같아요. 이재명 대통령은 드라이브를 세게 거는 스타일인데, 이걸 견제해야 된다고 많이들 생각한 거 같아요. 대통령도 사람이라 100% 옳을 수가 없는데 그걸 말해줄 사람이 필요하잖아요.”(신지현·38·여))

( “대통령이 에스엔에스로 소통을 활발히 하는 건 좋다고 생각해요. 근데 스타벅스 관련 글처럼, 사기업에 대한 제재를 국가가 해선 안 되는 건데… 그런 것도 선거에 영향을 주지 않았을까요.”(이민준·27·남))

■ "Profited from Stock Market Rise, But Considered 'Real Estate' in Elections" ()

The majority of participants were stock investors, and many had actually made profits. However, they said real estate issues had a much greater impact on young Seoul voters' sentiments than the stock market rise. As a generation facing housing instability, the rising jeonse (lump-sum deposit) and monthly rent prices and home values in Seoul seemed to heighten their sense of crisis. ( ■ “주가 상승으로 이득 봤지만…선거에선 ‘부동산’ 고려”)

"I do trade stocks. But I think real estate resonates more with people. Sure, I think the government deserves credit for raising the stock market. But it doesn't have the same impact as real estate. When the president talks about raising property taxes and cracking down on multi-homeowners, it actually causes listings to dry up, and people think 'I need to buy quickly,' which seems to drive prices up even more." (Jang Seong-min, 36, male) ( 대다수 참석자들은 주식 투자를 하고 있었고, 실제로 이득을 본 이들도 많았다. 그렇지만 이들은 주가 상승보다는 부동산 이슈가 서울 청년층 표심에 훨씬 큰 영향을 줬다고 했다. 주거 불안에 직면한 세대인 만큼 상승한 서울 전월세 가격과 매맷값은 이들에게 위기감을 키운 것 같았다.)

"It's true that housing prices in Seoul have skyrocketed under this administration. Jeonse is disappearing, and monthly rents are rising—it's disappointing for our generation in their 20s and 30s." (Jung Yoo-jin, 25, female) ( “저는 주식 하고 있고요. 근데 사람들에게 더 와닿는 건 부동산이라 생각해요. 물론 (정부·여당이) 주가를 올린 공이 높다고는 생각해요. 그런데 그게 부동산만큼 임팩트가 있진 않아요. (이 대통령이) 보유세 올린다, 다주택자 잡는다 이러니 오히려 매물이 잠기고, 사람들이 ‘빨리 사야겠다’고 생각해 집값이 더 오른 거 같아요.”(장성민·36·남))

"I wonder if the stock market really rose because the Lee Jae-myung administration did a good job. My SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics stocks have gone up ridiculously. But I think it's because the companies did well, not because the government intervened." (Kim Hyun-woo, 27, male) ( “이번 정부 들어 서울 집값이 폭등한 건 맞잖아요. 전세도 없어지고, 월세는 오르는 상황이다 보니 2030 세대로서는 아쉽죠.”(정유진·25·여))

"I think the current bull market is partly due to the Lee Jae-myung administration stabilizing the social atmosphere, and the announcement of several policies to foster related industries like AI also had an impact. That's something the government did well. But I don't think real estate is in a situation that can be driven by policy." (Shin Ji-hyun) ( “‘주가가 이재명 정부가 잘해서 올랐나’ 하는 생각이 듭니다. 제가 가진 에스케이(SK)하이닉스랑 삼성전자 주식이 말도 안 되게 오르긴 했어요. 그게 기업이 잘해서 올랐지 정부가 개입해서 올랐다고 생각하지 않아요.”(김현우·27·남))

( “저는 지금 주식시장이 호장인 게 이재명 정부가 사회적 분위기를 안정시킨 공이 있다고 생각하고요, 에이아이(AI) 같은 관련 산업 육성 정책을 여럿 발표한 것도 영향을 줬다고 생각해요. 그건 정부가 잘한 건 맞죠. 근데 부동산은 정책으로 드라이브할 수 있는 상황은 아니라고 봐요.”(신지현))

■ Facing the Election Commission: "Irresponsible" and "Incompetent" ( )

Participants in the FGI called the ballot paper shortage "absurd" and criticized the National Election Commission (NEC) for its "irresponsibility" and "incompetence." They said their right to vote must be guaranteed. They mentioned that going through the impeachments of former President Park Geun-hye in 2017 and former President Yoon Suk-yeol in 2025 increased their interest in elections and made them appreciate the value of their voting rights. They warned that the protest over the ballot shortage at Olympic Park should not be co-opted by specific political forces. ( ■ 선관위 향해 “무책임” “무능”)

"The NEC is incompetent. The system has collapsed." (Park Ji-hoon) ( 좌담회 참석자들은 투표지 부족 사태에 대해 “황당하다”며 중앙선거관리위원회(선관위)의 ‘무책임’과 ‘무능’을 성토했다. 이들은 참정권을 보장받아야 한다고 했다. 이들은 2017년 박근혜 전 대통령 탄핵과 2025년 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵을 거치며 선거에 대한 관심이 늘었고 투표권의 소중함을 체감했다고 말했다. 이들은 올림픽공원에 모인 투표지 부족 시위가 특정 정치세력에 의해 오염되어서는 안 된다고 경계했다.)

"Any company should do its job commensurate with the salary it receives and have the capability to perform. It's not the first or second time the NEC has been criticized for mishandling things; the organization itself has a problem." (Kim Hyun-woo) ( “선관위는 무능해요. 시스템이 무너졌어요.”(박지훈) )

"The 20s and 30s generation are people who have experienced two impeachments. People with a strong sense of needing to protect democracy probably came together." (Jung Yoo-jin) ( “어떤 기업이든 받은 급여만큼 일을 해야 하고, 수행 능력이 있어야 하잖아요. 선관위가 일처리를 잘못해서 욕먹는 것이 한두번도 아닌데 조직 자체가 문제가 있어요.”(김현우))

"This is a protest for voting rights, but I think we need to be wary of Christian groups or Taegeukgi Brigade taking it as an opportunity." (Oh Ji-eun, 30, female) ( “2030 세대는 두번의 탄핵을 겪은 사람들입니다. 민주주의를 지켜야겠다는 생각이 큰 사람들이 모이지 않았을까요.”(정유진) )

The 'June 3 Local Election Evaluation Focus Group Interview (FGI)' was commissioned by *The Hankyoreh* to the polling agency Human & Data and was held on the 10th at an office in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul. Considering the voting tendencies of the 20s and 30s generation, the discussion selected 14 participants, consisting of 7 voters in their 20s and 7 voters in their 30s, all living in Seoul. They were divided into groups of 20s and 30s and held a candid discussion for 1 hour and 30 minutes on the Seoul mayoral election results and the ballot paper shortage. ( “참정권 시위인데, 기독교나 태극기부대가 기회 삼아 오는 걸 경계해야 될 것 같아요.”(오지은·30·여))

Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr and Jo Hee-yeon, staff reporter choh@hani.co.kr (‘6·3 지방선거 평가 표적집단 심층면접(FGI) 좌담회’는 ‘한겨레’가 여론조사업체 휴먼앤데이터에 의뢰해 지난 10일 서울 영등포구의 사무실에서 열렸다. 좌담회 참석자들은 2030 세대의 투표 성향을 고려해 서울에 사는 남녀 20대 유권자 7명과 30대 유권자 7명 등 14명을 선정했다. 이들은 20대와 30대로 나눠 1시간30분 동안 서울시장 선거 결과와 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 가감 없는 토론을 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Sends Congratulatory Message to Putin on Russia Day, "Opening a New Chapter in North Korea-Russia History" (김정은, 러시아 국경일 맞아 푸틴에 축전 “북러 새 역사의 장 펼쳐”)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un sent a congratulatory message to Russian President Vladimir Putin on the occasion of Russia Day (June 12), stating, "Today, North Korea-Russia relations are opening a new chapter in history and are being further strengthened into a relationship of sincere and devoted comradely trust and an alliance." (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 러시아 국경일(러시아의 날·6월12일)을 맞아 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령에게 축전을 보내 “오늘 조로(북러)관계는 새로운 역사의 장을 펼치며 진실하고 헌신적인 동지적 신뢰관계, 동맹관계로 더욱 강화되고 있다”고 했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun reported on its front page on the 12th that Chairman Kim had sent such a congratulatory message. According to the message, Chairman Kim said, "It is a proud resolution achieved by the two countries (North Korea and Russia) faithfully fulfilling the obligations of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership and the ideals of justice, and it demonstrates the legitimacy of our choice." Chairman Kim also stated, "Supporting Moscow's domestic and foreign policies and always standing with the Russian Federation is the unwavering will and position of myself and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea." This reiterated his support for Russian policies as an ally. (노동신문은 12일 1면에 김 위원장이 이런 내용의 축전을 보냈다고 보도했다. 축전 내용을 보면 김 위원장은 “(북러) 두 나라가 포괄적인 전략적 동반자 관계에 관한 조약의 의무와 정의의 이념에 충실함으로써 획득한 자부할 만한 결심이며 우리의 선택이 정당하다는 것을 실증해주고 있다”고 했다. 김 위원장은 또 “모스크바의 대내외 정책들을 지지하고 언제나 러시아 연방과 함께 하려는 것은 나와 조선민주주의인민공화국 정부의 변함없는 의지이며 입장”이라고 했다. 동맹으로서 러시아 정책에 대한 지지를 거듭 표명한 것이다.)

Chairman Kim further expressed familiarity by addressing President Putin as "my close friend" and "Comrade Vladimir Putin." (김 위원장은 푸틴 대통령을 “친근한 나의 벗”이자 “울(블)라디미르 푸틴 동지”라고 칭하며 친근감을 더했다.)

Chairman Kim sent this new congratulatory message about a month after sending one to President Putin on the 81st anniversary of Russia's Victory Day last month. The Rodong Sinmun also published an article on page 6 titled "Russia Striving Vigorously for Justice and Truth," promoting Russia's economic and military development. (김 위원장은 지난달 9일 러시아의 전승절 81주년을 맞아 푸틴 대통령에게 축전을 보낸 뒤 한달여 만에 새 축전을 보냈다. 노동신문은 이날 6면에도 ‘정의와 진리를 위해 힘차게 매진하는 러시아’라는 제목의 기사를 게재해 러시아가 경제·군사적으로 발전하고 있다고 선전했다.)

To mark Russia Day, the Russian Embassy in North Korea also held a celebratory banquet. The banquet was attended by North Korean Minister of External Economic Relations Yun Jong-ho, Workers' Party Deputy Department Director An Hyon-min, and Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jong-gyu. (국경일을 맞아 북한 주재 러시아 대사관도 축하 연회를 열었다. 연회엔 윤정호 대외경제상과 안현민 노동당 부부장, 김정규 외무성 부상 등이 초대됐다.)

'Russia Day' was established to commemorate the adoption of the Declaration of State Sovereignty of the Russian Republic by the Congress of People's Deputies of Russia, the Russian parliament, following the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the establishment of the Russian Federation. (‘러시아의 날’은 소련 해체 뒤 러시아 연방을 설립하면서 러시아 의회인 인민대의원대회가 러시아 공화국의 주권 선언문을 채택한 것을 기념해 제정됐다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating falls by 7 percentage points… 'Election commission issues' top reason for negative assessment [Gallup] (이 대통령 지지율 7%p 하락…‘선관위 문제’ 부정평가 이유 1위 [갤럽])
item.description:
According to a poll released on the 12th, positive assessments of President Lee Jae-myung's governance have dropped by 7 percentage points compared to three weeks ago. (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정평가가 3주 전보다 7%포인트 하락했다는 여론조사 결과가 12일 나왔다.)

In a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 9th to the 11th across 1,002 eligible voters aged 18 and older nationwide (with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via mobile phone virtual number interviews), 57% gave a positive evaluation of the president's job performance, while 35% gave a negative one. In the survey three weeks prior (May 19-21), conducted before the June 3 local elections, the positive rating was 64% and the negative rating was 28%. This represents a 7 percentage point drop in positive assessments and a 7 percentage point rise in negative ones. <<> Reasons cited for positive evaluations included the economy and people's livelihoods (21%), diplomacy (12%), and overall good performance (9%). For negative evaluations, issues such as 'mismanagement, electoral fraud, and problems with the National Election Commission' (16%), the economy, livelihoods, and high exchange rates (14%), and housing policy (9%) were pointed out. Gallup Korea explained, "The president's positive job approval rating has fallen below 60% for the first time in four months," adding, "The most commonly cited reason for negative job performance evaluations was issues with the election commission, reflecting the aftermath of the ballot paper shortage." <<> In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea stood at 41%, down from 45% three weeks ago. The People Power Party, which was at 22% in the previous survey, rose by 7 percentage points to 29%. The proportion of independents was 21%. Gallup explained, "The gap between the two major parties has narrowed from 30 percentage points in early April to 23 percentage points in mid-May, and then to 12 percentage points this week." <<> For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. <<> Reporter Jang Narae wing@hani.co.kr (한국갤럽이 지난 9∼11일 전국 만 18살 이상 유권자 1002명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 휴대전화 가상번호 전화 인터뷰)에서, 이 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 57%, 부정 평가는 35%였다. 6·3 지방선거 전에 이뤄진 3주 전(5월19∼21일) 조사에선 긍정 평가 64%, 부정 평가 28%였는데, 긍·부정 평가가 각각 7%포인트 하락, 7%포인트 상승한 것이다.)

item.title: Full re-election support 44%, opposition 48%… Among 20s-30s, support reaches 60% [Gallup] (전면 재선거 찬성 44%, 반대 48%…2030에선 찬성이 60%대 [갤럽])
item.description:
Amid calls for a re-election from some quarters due to the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections, public opinion on the matter has shown a stark generational divide. (6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태로 일각에서 재선거 요구가 나오는 가운데 이에 대한 찬반 여론은 세대별로 극명하게 갈린 것으로 나타났다.)

In a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 9th to the 11th targeting 1,002 eligible voters aged 18 and over nationwide (with a margin of error of ±3.1% points at a 95% confidence level, via mobile phone virtual number interviews), respondents were asked, “What do you think about the claim that a full re-election should be held?” The results showed 44% in favor and 48% opposed. ( 한국갤럽이 지난 9∼11일 전국 만 18살 이상 유권자 1002명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 휴대전화 가상번호 전화 인터뷰)에서 ‘전면 재선거 해야 한다는 주장에 대해 어떻게 생각하느냐’고 묻자 찬성이 44%, 반대가 48%로 집계됐다. )

Broken down by age, support for the claim that “a full re-election should be held” was 67% among those in their 20s or younger and 62% among those in their 30s, while it was 36% among those in their 40s, 38% among those in their 50s, 32% among those in their 60s, and 34% among those aged 70 or older—a clear temperature difference. ( 연령별로 보면 ‘전면 재선거를 해야 한다는 주장’에 대해 찬성한다는 응답이 20대 이하에서 67%, 30대에서 62%였던 반면, 40대에선 36%, 50대에선 38%, 60대에선 32%, 70대 이상에선 34%로 온도 차가 컸다. )

Gallup Korea also asked whether the “ballot shortage incident” was a matter of “poor election management and infringement of voting rights” or “evidence of illegal election interference and attempted election fraud.” 67% of respondents said it was “poor election management and infringement of voting rights,” while 25% said it was “evidence of illegal election interference and attempted election fraud.” Across generations, the overwhelming majority viewed it as poor election management rather than election fraud (64% among those in their 20s or younger, 61% among those in their 30s, 81% among those in their 40s, 72% among those in their 50s, 68% among those in their 60s, and 53% among those aged 70 or older). Gallup Korea interpreted this, saying, “Although those in their 20s and 30s see the ballot shortage incident as poor election management rather than election fraud, their tendency to lean toward a full re-election is presumed to stem from an emphasis on fairness in the process over the outcome.” ( 한국갤럽은 ‘투표용지 부족사태’가 ‘부실한 선거 관리와 참정권 침해 문제’인지 ‘불법적 선거개입, 부정선거 시도 증거’인지도 질문했다. 응답자의 67%는 ‘부실한 선거 관리, 참정권 침해 문제’라고 답했고 25%는 ‘불법적 선거 개입, 부정선거 시도 증거’라고 했다. 세대별로 봐도 부정 선거가 아닌 부실 선거(20대 이하 64%, 30대 61%, 40대 81%, 50대 72%, 60대 68%, 70대 이상 53%)라는 입장이 절대다수였다. 한국갤럽은 “20·30대가 투표용지 부족 사태를 부정선거 아닌 부실선거로 보면서도 전면 재선거 쪽으로 기운 것은 결과에 앞선 과정상 공정성 중시 경향에서 비롯한 현상으로 짐작된다”고 풀이했다. )

In this survey, Gallup Korea also conducted a preference poll asking, “Who is suitable as a future president?” Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon received 9%, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon received 8%, and former leader of the Innovation Party Cho Kuk received 7%. Following them were Prime Minister Kim Min-seok (5%), People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk (3%), and Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik (2%). For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission’s website. ( 한국갤럽은 이번 조사에서 ‘ 장래 대통령감으로 누가 좋은지’ 선호도 조사도 함께 벌였다. 오세훈 서울시장이 9%, 한동훈 무소속 의원이 8%, 조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 7%로 나타났고, 김민석 국무총리(5%), 장동혁 국민의힘 대표(3%), 강훈식 대통령비서실장(2%) 등이 뒤를 이었다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의의원회 누리집을 보면 된다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ( 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: The Democratic Party, Seeking to Renew Itself in Gwangju... Leadership Clashes Again Publicly (광주서 절치부심하려던 민주당…지도부 또 ‘공개 충돌’)
item.description:
Members of the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership publicly clashed once again at an on-site Supreme Council meeting held in Gwangju on the 12th. Amid escalating internal party strife ahead of the June 3 local election evaluation and the August party convention, criticism over Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's responsibility and calls for his resignation were raised again, along with public criticism directed at Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who is also mentioned as a potential candidate for party leadership. (더불어민주당 지도부 의원들이 12일 광주에서 열린 현장 최고위원회의에서 또 한 번 공개 충돌했다. 6·3 지방선거 평가와 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 당내 갈등이 격화하는 가운데 정청래 대표 책임론과 사퇴 요구가 재차 제기됐고, 또 다른 당권 주자로 거론되는 김민석 국무총리를 향한 공개 비판까지 나왔다.)

At the on-site Supreme Council meeting held at the Kim Dae-jung Convention Center in Gwangju that day, Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon stated, "We did not win the June 3 local elections. We failed. In places we could have won and should not have lost, the leadership, including myself and the party leader, were all insufficient." He added, "I urge a responsible stance from the leadership." (이날 광주 김대중 컨벤션 센터에서 열린 현장 최고위원회의에서 황명선 최고위원은 “우리는 6·3 지방선거에서 승리하지 못했다. 실패했다. 이길 수 있는 곳, 져서는 안 되는 곳에 저를 포함한, 당 대표를 포함한 지도부 모두가 부족했다”며 “지도부의 책임 있는 자세를 촉구한다”고 했다.)

Following him, Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, seemingly referring to Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's remark on the 10th that "The people are eternal, and the government is short," opened his remarks by saying, "The people and party members are eternal, but party power is short." Kang continued, "We must also engrave in our hearts the truth that while politicians engage in politics, the evaluation, judgment, and verdict belong to the people. We must not avoid uncomfortable voices or take criticism as an attack. We need to be a party that listens and takes responsibility to the end." (뒤이어 발언에 나선 강득구 최고위원도 지난 10일 정청래 대표의 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”는 발언을 염두에 둔 듯 “국민과 당원은 영원하지만 당권은 짧다”고 포문을 열었다. 강 최고위원은 “정치는 정치인이 하지만 평가와 판단, 심판은 국민의 몫이라는 진리 또한 가슴에 새겨야 한다”며 “불편한 목소리를 회피해선 안 되고 비판을 공격으로 받아들여선 안 된다. 끝까지 듣고 책임지는 정당이 돼야 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok, who is close to Representative Jeong, launched a counterattack, saying, "Faced with a great stream ahead, we must not snatch oars from each other inside the boat." Moon stated, "Once elections are over, evaluation is necessary. But evaluation must not become the language of division. Words and actions that shake the party over election results or try to set the party's direction ahead of the members' choices are by no means characteristic of the Democratic Party." (그러자 정 대표와 가까운 문정복 최고위원이 “큰 물길을 앞에 두고 배 안에서 서로 노를 빼앗아서는 안 된다”며 반격에 나섰다. 문 최고위원은 “선거가 끝나면 평가는 필요하다. 그러나 평가가 분열의 언어가 되어선 안 된다”며 “선거 결과를 이유로 당을 흔들고 당원들의 선택보다 앞서 당의 방향을 정하려는 듯한 말과 행동은 결코 민주당스럽지 않다”고 했다.)

Moon then added, "The more President Lee Jae-myung is on overseas trips for the national interest, the more the party and government must solidly support state affairs. It is appreciated that Prime Minister Kim Min-seok takes time to congratulate elected members, but during the president's overseas trip, is it truly urgent for the person acting on behalf of the state to give congratulatory speeches and take photos at the elected members' workshop for two consecutive days?" She further noted, "No words or actions should be misunderstood as improperly influencing party affairs." (문 최고위원은 이어 “이재명 대통령께서 국익을 위해 해외순방을 나선 시간일수록 당과 정부는 더욱 공고하게 국정을 뒷받침해야 한다”며 “(김민석 국무)총리께서 시간을 쪼개 당선자들에게 축하하는 것은 고마운 일이나, 대통령 순방 중에 국가를 대리하는 책임자가 연이틀 당선자 워크숍에서 축사하고 사진 찍는 게 급박한 업무일 건 아니”라고 했다. 그러면서 “어떤 말과 행동도 당무에 부당한 영향을 주는 것으로 오해받아선 안 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon commented, "The one-person-one-vote system of our party was an achievement to build a party where members are sovereign. Shaking or denying the one-person-one-vote system that our members have achieved cannot be overlooked." The one-person-one-vote system is considered one of Representative Jeong's key pledges. (이성윤 최고위원은 “(민주당의) 1인1표제는 당원 주권정당 민주당을 만들기 위해 이룩한 성과”라며 “당원들이 이뤄낸 1인1표제를 흔들고 부정하는 건 묵과할 수 없다”고 말하기도 했다. 1인1표제는 정 대표의 핵심 공약으로 꼽힌다.)

As the atmosphere heated up, Representative Jeong delivered closing remarks, saying, "President Lee said, 'Would the small differences among us be greater than those of the other side?' and spoke of unity and solidarity. As the president said, the more difficult it is for the Democratic Party, the more we must unite." Jeong added, "We must not insist that things different are wrong." (분위기가 고조되자, 정 대표는 회의 마무리 발언에 나서 “이 대통령께서 ‘우리 안의 작은 차이가 상대방의 그것보다 크겠느냐’며 단합·단결을 말씀하셨다”며 “대통령의 말씀처럼 민주당이 어려울수록 더 단결해야 한다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 “다른 것을 틀렸다고 주장하면 안 된다”고 했다.)

Earlier, at the meeting, Representative Jeong also said, "Honam is like a parent to the Democratic Party. Like a parent who always embraces both a competent and an incompetent child, I am grateful to Honam for always embracing and cherishing the Democratic Party even when it falls short." item.title: [Exclusive] Non-standing Election Committee Chair Noh Tae-ak Attended Only Half the Time in 3 Months Before Election ([단독] ‘비상임’ 선관위원장 노태악, 선거 전 3개월간 절반만 출근)
item.description:
Amid ongoing criticism of the Central Election Commission's poor management of the election system, it has been confirmed that former Central Election Commission Chair Noh Tae-ak actually showed up for work only half the days in the three months leading up to the election. Even considering that the election commission chair is a non-standing position with no obligation to commute, it is difficult to view this as being diligent in election management duties. <<> According to data submitted by the Central Election Commission to the office of Yoon Geon-young, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, on the 12th, from March 3, when former Chair Noh retired as a Supreme Court justice, to election day, he performed work on only 34 out of 60 statutory working days—barely over half. <<> Of the 29 days when exact commute times could be confirmed, he arrived at work by 9 a.m. on just a single day. On 14 days—nearly half—he arrived in the afternoon, and there were even days when he came in at 4 p.m. Meanwhile, his departure times were early: he left before 6 p.m. on a total of 21 days. On election day itself, he arrived at 9:30 a.m. <<> Even on days he performed work, there were many instances where his time at the office was only about two hours. For example, on May 27, one week before the main voting day, former Chair Noh is recorded as arriving at 3:05 p.m. and leaving at 5:30 p.m. On March 11, he is recorded as coming to the office at 10:55 a.m. and leaving at 12:50 p.m., working for just 1 hour and 55 minutes. <<> This attendance pattern is possible because the Central Election Commission chair is a non-standing position with no fixed obligation to commute. By convention, the chair is concurrently held by one of the Supreme Court justices, and the issue of being unable to fully commit to election commission duties while holding a primary job has long been pointed out. This is why calls have been raised to reform the non-standing system. However, former Chair Noh retired as a Supreme Court justice on March 3, three months before the election, putting him in a position to focus on the election commission chair role virtually full-time. <<> The Central Election Commission maintains that, given the nature of election commission work, it is difficult to see a problem with former Chair Noh's attendance. An official from the Central Election Commission told The Hankyoreh, "In March and April, there weren't many issues that required the chair to receive real-time reports. During the period after candidate registration, when workload surges, he came in almost every day," adding, "Since it's a part-time role with no set commuting hours, arriving late doesn't necessarily mean he was negligent in his duties. If anything, he attended more frequently than past (election commission chairs)." <<> Regarding former Chair Noh's late arrival on election day, the official said, "He voted at 9 a.m. and came straight to work. He could have voted earlier, but I understand he did it at 9 a.m. for the convenience of media coverage." <<> Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (중앙선거관리위원회의 선거 시스템 관리부실이 연일 지적되는 가운데, 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 선거를 앞둔 3개월 동안 실제 출근한 날이 절반에 불과했던 것으로 확인됐다. 선관위원장은 비상임직으로 출퇴근 의무가 없다는 점을 고려하더라도, 선거관리 업무에 충실했다고 보기 어려운 지점이다.)

item.title: On 'Yoon Suk Yeol's 30-Year Sentence,' Democratic Party Says "Price of Treason, Justice Has Its Day" (‘윤석열 징역 30년’에…민주 “반역의 대가, 사필귀정”)
item.description:
When former President Yoon Suk Yeol was sentenced to 30 years in prison in the first trial on charges of general sedition for orchestrating a drone infiltration operation into Pyongyang to provoke North Korea as a pretext for martial law, the Democratic Party of Korea responded by calling it "the price of treason" and "justice has its day." (계엄 명분용으로 북한 도발을 유도하기 위해 평양 무인기 침투 작전을 펼쳐 일반이적 혐의로 기소된 윤석열 전 대통령에게 1심에서 징역 30년이 선고되자 더불어민주당은 “반역의 대가”이자 “사필귀정”이라는 반응을 보였다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Kim Han-na said in a written briefing on the 12th, "The 30-year prison sentence is the judiciary's stern judgment on anti-state crimes that used national security as a tool to extend power," adding, "Justice has its day." Spokesperson Kim pointed out, "The duty of the commander-in-chief is to protect the people from the flames of war, but President Yoon Suk Yeol, far from using security as a shield, used it as a sword to destroy the constitutional order, threaten the lives of the people, and push the Korean Peninsula into a war crisis." She added, "We will continue to hold him accountable and remember this so that never again can insurrectionary foreign acts disguised as security or power run amok threatening peace be used as political gambling chips against the people's lives." <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ju-min called former President Yoon "the great traitor of Korean history" on Facebook on the 12th, calling the verdict "a perfectly natural result." Lawmaker Park added, "For his own political purposes, using the risk of war as a pretext, the weight of the crime of pointing a gun at the people he should protect has finally been confirmed in the name of the law. We must clearly record in history what consequences follow for those who betrayed the people and destroyed the constitution, so that such people never appear again." <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Han Jun-ho also posted on Facebook the same day, saying, "30 years in prison is the price of treason," and "It is light compared to the weight of the crime of endangering the Republic of Korea." Lawmaker Han said of the December 3 insurrection, "It was not an accidental event," and "It was a planned crime that created a war crisis for martial law and trampled democracy and the constitution for power." <<> Along with the assessment of "justice has its day" (from lawmaker Lee Gwang-hee), there was also a comment that "compared to a head of state harming the lives and safety of the people by violating military interests, the sentence is by no means heavy" (from lawmaker Kim Nam-joon). <<> Park Byeong-eon, senior spokesperson for the Rebuilding Korea Party, said in a commentary that day, "For Yoon who tried to break through his own political crisis with 'Korean-style McCarthyism' and the implementation of emergency martial law, the court imposed severe punishment to tell him to stop his delusions," adding, "The court's message is clear: plans to use North Korea for domestic politics will no longer be tolerated." <<> Son Sol, senior spokesperson for the Progressive Party, also said in a written briefing that day, "30 years in prison is a historical condemnation of treason," calling it "justice has its day." Spokesperson Son emphasized, "This verdict is a stern judgment on the rulers who pushed the nation and its people into a war crisis to maintain power and personal gain," adding, "The madness of those who tried to induce inter-Korean military conflict and even risk war for the sake of the regime is an unforgivable act of treason." <<> Criminal Division 36 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Lee Jeong-yeop) held the first trial sentencing hearing for former President Yoon on charges including general sedition and abuse of power obstructing the exercise of rights, sentencing him to 30 years in prison. Former Defense Minister Kim Yong-hyun, also charged with the same offenses, received a 30-year prison sentence, and former Defense Intelligence Command Commander Yeo In-hyung received a 15-year sentence. Former Drone Operations Command Commander Kim Yong-dae, who faced charges of abuse of power and inciting damage to military property for directing the drone operation, was sentenced to three years in prison with a five-year suspended sentence. Former President Yoon and others are accused of conducting a drone operation in October and November 2024 to provoke a North Korean provocation as a pretext for declaring emergency martial law. The court stated, "Former President Yoon, former Minister Kim, and former Commander Yeo deliberately created an emergency situation to exercise the authority to declare emergency martial law." <<> Reporter Lee Yu-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr ( 김한나 민주당 대변인은 12일 서면브리핑을 내어 “징역 30년 선고는 국가안보를 권력 연장의 도구로 삼은 반국가 범죄에 대한 사법부의 엄중한 심판”이라며 “사필귀정”이라며 말했다. 김 대변인은 “국군통수권자의 책무는 국민을 전쟁의 불길에서 지키는 것이지만 대통령 윤석열은 안보를 방패로 삼기는커녕, 안보를 칼로 삼아 헌정질서를 파괴하고 국민의 생명을 위협했으며, 한반도를 전쟁 위기로 몰아세웠다”고 지적했다. 그러면서 “다시는 안보를 가장한 내란적 외환 행위, 평화를 위협한 권력의 폭주로 국민의 생명을 정치적 도박 판돈으로 삼지 못하도록 끝까지 그 책임을 묻고 기억하겠다”고 덧붙였다. )
